About Me

(Bio)

I'm Joep Smit, 23, a Communication & Multimedia Design student at HvA with a UX/UI focus, currently on exchange in Melbourne. From February 2027 I'm looking for a 100-day internship where I can work on products that people actually use.

I like building websites and interactive experiences, by hand in HTML, CSS and JavaScript and in tools like Figma, and figuring out how to make them work better for the people using them, from booking flows to data visualisation. This portfolio collects a few real projects where I got to practise that.

Alongside my studies I have almost 7 years of hospitality experience. For the hospitality projects in this portfolio that gives me a head start: I already know the operational side, so I can focus on getting the interface right.
